**Finding: missing** (INSURANCE — Vendor insurance)

The Agreement has no insurance provision at all:
- A full-text search for insurance/coverage/policy terms returned zero hits.
- § 14.12 (Risk of Loss) only allocates risk of loss between Base Components (IBM) and Customer Components (Customer) — no coverage obligation.
- § 5.3 (Security) is a series of disclaimers ("IBM does not warrant secure operation…", "IBM shall have no liability…") rather than a covenant to insure.

IBM is squarely within the rule's scope: it operates the e-business Hosting Environment and, under § 14.18, processes personal information on our behalf as part of the Services. That places the current position in walk-away territory (no insurance for a vendor processing personal data).

**Redline (validated, ok:true):** new "Insurance" clause inserted into the Section 14 miscellaneous block after § 14.19, at the preferred position — CGL USD 1M per occurrence / 2M aggregate, E&O USD 2M, cyber/privacy USD 5M, workers' compensation as required by law, certificates on request, maintained through the term plus one year. The comment offers the E&O USD 1M / cyber USD 2M fallback if IBM pushes back on limits.
